_comment: Recombinator (Sentinel league, 3.18): combines two items of the same item class. For each side, the prefixes (or suffixes) of both items go into one pool; the result gets a number of them that depends on the pool size, picked at random.

Source: community testing posted during 3.18 Sentinel (reddit r/pathofexile 'Recombinator mechanics' threads, summarised on the PoE wiki 'Recombinator' page). GGG never published these numbers. Not re-verified from the build environment.
keepCounts[n] = [[mods kept, chance], ...] for a pool of n mods on one side. approximate: true makes the app label recombinator plans as approximate and advanced.
Exclusive mods and the chance of an extra random mod aren't modelled.
